title: Peppermint Eggnog Punch
description: This punch is so delicious, I sometimes make a batch without the rum because the kids enjoy it as much as the adults!
ingredients: 4 (12 fluid ounce) cans or bottles ginger ale, chilled
24 small peppermint candy canes for garnish

steps.text: Set aside 2 or 3 round scoops of ice cream in the freezer for garnish. Stir remaining ice cream until softened. Gradually stir in eggnog and rum. Transfer to a punch bowl, and stir in ginger ale. Hang candy canes around the edge of the punchbowl. Float reserved ice cream scoops on top, and serve immediately.

video.description: Do you love eggnog? If so, be sure to watch this video to learn how to turn this holiday beverage into a festive punch. It's easy too! Just stir in softened peppermint ice cream, a cup of rum, and ginger ale. That's all! Serve right away, garnished with a candy cane.
